{{Quote|The strategy is working perfectly, my lord. The Jedi and their forces are spread thin across the Outer Rim worlds in a vain effort to contain our new offensive.|[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="CW22">{{CW|22}}</ref>}}
The '''Outer Rim Sieges''' ([[20 BBY/Legends|20]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]) were the series of fierce battles that took place throughout the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], such as [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], which marked the final phase of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
===Fighting in the Outer Rim===
{{Quote|General Grievous reports all is in readiness, Master. The Jedi and the Republic will become enmeshed in sieges on the Outer Rim. Once committed, they will find themselves unable to break off. It will leave them vulnerable to Grievous's strike force.|[[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="Republic 73" />}}
[[File:Battleofbozpity.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]]]]
From the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] struggled to gain an advantage over the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By [[20 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]], thirty [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the conflict,<ref name="TNEC" /> the Republic, having finally committed enough of its industrial might toward the war effort, was winning the war.<ref name="Warfare" /> The Republic won a series of key battles at [[Second battle of Duro|Duro]], [[Battle of Commenor (Clone Wars)|Commenor]], and [[Battle of Balmorra (Clone Wars)|Balmorra]], driving the Confederacy from its bases in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] retreated to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], reinforcing its vast holdings on both sides of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] also had other Confederate forces marshaled at [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]], [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]], [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]].<ref name="Republic 73" /> The Outer Rim Sieges began when, in response to the Separatist retreat, the Republic became fully committed to pummeling CIS bases at the borders of the Rim.<ref name="TNEC" />

Besides targeting [[Battle of Ryloth (Outer Rim Sieges)|Ryloth]] and [[Battle of Ossus (Outer Rim Sieges)|Ossus]],<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led fleets from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] assaulted [[Battle of Ord Radama (Clone Wars)|Ord Radama]] and [[Battle of New Bornalex|New Bornalex]] in an effort to reach [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and Count Dooku's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Republic forces pursued the Separatists from [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], eventually sparking the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]; and also from [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] to [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|Bomis Koori IV]], [[Battle of Tar Morden|Tar Morden]], and [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]], with further fighting break out at [[Battle of Triton|Triton]] and [[Battle of Llanic|Llanic]].<ref name="TEA" /> Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] launched from [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]] and [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] to clear the outer [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]],<ref name="Warfare" /> attacking [[Battle of Siskeen|Siskeen]] and [[Battle of Tellanroaeg|Tellanroaeg]].<ref name="TEA" /> Grievous commanded multiple [[Division/Legends|divisions]] of [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Koorivar Fusiliers]] during the sieges<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> in addition to droid forces.<ref name="CW22" />

Besides the Battle of Kashyyyk, pivotal battles of the Outer Rim Sieges became the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]]<ref name="Warfare" /> (19.43 BBY),<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], and the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Traavis]] led a series of campaigns against the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]] of [[Battle of Monhudle|Monhudle]], [[Battle of New Bakstre|New Bakstre]], and [[Battle of Biitu|Biitu]], later moving his forces to [[Battle of Garqi (Clone Wars)|assault]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]].<ref name="Insider 87: Order 66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Battle of the Ywllandr system|victory]] at the [[Ywllandr system/Legends|Ywllandr system]] allowed Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to [[Battle of Mygeeto|invade]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Another battlefront [[Battle of Belderone|became]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]], where General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had planned to hide the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], forcing him to move the Council to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Morale in the Core became high, as much of the Republic citizenry believed that the end of the war was near.<ref name="TNEC" />

In reality, the purpose of the Outer Rim Sieges was to enmesh the majority of the Republic's forces at the fringes of its borders. Once committed, the Jedi and their detachments from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] found themselves unable to break off, leaving [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the Core Worlds vulnerable. With the Republic's attention focused in the Outer Rim,<ref name="CW22" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] about to discover his secret alter ego of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious<ref name="TNEC" />&mdash;ordered General Grievous, as Sidious, to target the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], six months into the Outer Rim Sieges.<ref name="CW22" />

===Victory for the Republic===
[[File:Outerrimsieges.png|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi concludes a briefing on the Outer Rim Sieges]]
{{Quote|You missed the report on the Outer Rim Sieges.''"<br />"''I'm sorry, I was held up. I have no excuse.''"<br />"''In short, they are going very well. Saleucami has fallen, and Master Vos has moved his troops to Boz Pity.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The Sieges&mdash;and the war in general&mdash;were brought to an abrupt end when Palpatine ordered the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to carry out [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a contingency plan meant to exterminate all the Jedi should they ever betray the Republic. Spread thinly throughout the galaxy and isolated from each other, the Jedi were caught off guard when their clone soldiers turned on them, and most of them were killed immediately in the opening minutes of what became the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. On [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] killed the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|deactivated the droid armies]], bringing the CIS to an end. Palpatine then declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor of the galaxy]], and reorganized the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
